name: MA-04
label: Safe D

key_factors: Auchincloss's huge financial advantage ($7.3M cash vs $1.3K)
Incumbency and lack of any competitive polling
model.rationale: Auchincloss holds a D+11 district with a massive fundraising edge and no credible polling or ratings suggesting competition; markets price him near certain. The fundamentals-based margin of roughly 22 points stands with only minor adjustment.
model.watch: A late surge of outside spending against Auchincloss or an unusually strong Republican national environment could narrow the margin, though not plausibly the outcome.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Jake Auchincloss seeks another term in a Massachusetts district that leans Democratic by about 11 points on the partisan index. He has raised over $3.6 million and holds $7.3 million on hand, while Republican Thomas Stalcup has raised roughly $26,000 with almost no cash remaining. No general-election polls or expert ratings are available for the race, and no outside spending has been reported on either side.

Prediction markets price a Democratic win at about 97 percent. With the incumbent running, a large money advantage, and the district's lean, the race sits firmly in Safe D territory, with an expected Democratic margin in the low twenties.
